reference.title: Scenario 13 — Admonition Between Numbered List in a Workflow
reference.shortdesc: Consider a workflow where the author has inserted an admonition (Note or Warning style paragraph)

section.p: Consider a workflow where the author has inserted an admonition (Note or Warning style paragraph) between two numbered items to call out supplementary or cautionary information relevant to the stage just described.

row.entry: [Heading 2]: Release Workflow [List Number]: 1. Merge the release branch. [Note style]: Merging triggers an automatic build in the CI pipeline. [List Number]: 2. Tag the release.

entry.codeblock:
Release Workflow
  1. Merge the release branch.

    Merging triggers an automatic build in the CI pipeline.
  2. Tag the release.

section.p: Result: In a concept or workflow context, the admonition is nested inside the preceding <li> as a <note> element.
